what_happened: The job to give OLY-B-D2-02 a mechanism for site accessibility, tracks and a learning path was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave one major finding and no blockers. In the default core track, every claim citation link goes nowhere. The expert sections (EXPERT_SECTIONS in xtask/src/site.rs:673) are hidden by CSS (.expert{display:none}, line 962), and the claims list they point to is among them. So the page header's promise that claims are listed at the end is false. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks.
cause: Nothing checks the generated page as a reader sees it in each track. The track feature hides sections with CSS, and the reading and tests did not require every in-page link and every statement about page content to still resolve in the default track. Link integrity depends on which sections are visible, but the hiding list and the claims list were designed separately. The claims section was put in the hidden set, and no test rendered the default track and followed its anchors.
other_causes: Acceptance criteria probably checked that tracks and a learning path exist, not that each track's page is self-consistent.
The page header's claim about where claims are listed is static text, not tied to what is shown.
open_hypotheses: The event does not show whether any criterion covered link integrity per track, so it is unknown whether the criteria missed it or the producer missed it.
It is unknown whether the producer ran the generator and looked at the default-track output.
contradictions: No acceptance criterion is listed as unmet and no check failed, so the usual presence-versus-behavior criterion gap cannot be confirmed from the fields.
prevention: Add a code check to the site generator's tests. For each track, render the page and verify that every in-page anchor link resolves to an element that is not hidden in that track. Also verify that any section the header names, such as the claims list, is visible in that track. Fail the test on any dead link. Require every site-generation job that adds visibility modes to pass this check before the final verdict.
proposed_request: Fix the site generator so the default core track has no dead links. Outcome: in every track, including the default core track, every claim citation link on the generated page resolves to a visible target, and the page header's statement that claims are listed at the end is true. Keep the claims list visible in all tracks. Expert-only detail may stay hidden. Add a test in xtask that renders each track and fails if any in-page anchor points to a missing or hidden element, or if the header names a section that is hidden. Run the new test, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test, and cite the commands that ran. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.
